instruction: Open beta_notes.txt from Documents and count the case-sensitive whole-word occurrences of window. Save only the decimal count in Documents\window_count.txt, then open the output and verify it.
_comments: E2 held-out evaluation variant. Never use it for a human demonstration or Compiler input.

command:
from pathlib import Path; source=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents eta_notes.txt'); source.write_text('window door window
WINDOW stays uppercase
windows is plural
open the window
a windowed app
window
final window
', encoding='utf-8'); Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\window_count.txt').unlink(missing_ok=True)
from pathlib import Path; p=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\window_count.txt'); print('true' if p.is_file() and p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').strip() == '5' else 'false', end='')
